outline:
本課程著重介紹電腦輔助製造技術的概念與實作。內容包括NC基本概念，一般機械零件之NC與APT程式製作，複雜曲面零件之NC程式製作，CAM系統實習，群組技術電腦輔助製程規劃，電腦輔助製程規劃系統實習，電腦輔助生產規劃。
This course has been prepared for the comprehensive of Computer-aided manufacturing, with emphasis on the essentials of CNC technology and programming. Through the projects practice, the students are able to adapt to the techniques of CAM.
